name: Yamazaki Takashi
source:
Got a crush on your teacher? But wait, he’s a nerd!
Meet the main character (yukio)’s math teacher whom Yukio has a crush on! Yamazaki is super plain and… so old fashioned…
Moreover… he is strict and is a little bit cold towards everyone.
It’s a mystery how his glasses always covers his eyes (fact Yoshida loves tease him about)!
You'll never meet a bigger nerd of a teacher!
